name: class-fold
description: Intelligent inline folding for Tailwind CSS classes, JSX classNames, SVG paths, and long image URLs.

commands.title: Class Fold: Toggle Fold on Current Line
Class Fold: Unfold All in Active File
Class Fold: Re-Fold All in Active File
Class Fold: Copy Folded Content Under Cursor

classFold.enabled.description: Enable or disable Class Fold inline folding.

classFold.maskChar.description: The mask string or emoji displayed in place of folded content (e.g., '...', '⚡', '◈◈◈', '[class]').

classFold.useTypeSpecificMasks.description: Use dedicated mask characters for different types of folded content (classes, images, and SVGs).

classFold.maskCharClass.description: Mask string displayed for folded HTML/JSX classes when type-specific masks are enabled.

classFold.maskCharImage.description: Mask string displayed for folded image src and base64 URLs.

classFold.maskCharSvg.description: Mask string displayed for folded SVG paths and points.

classFold.maskCharCustom.description: Mask string displayed for user-defined custom pattern matches.

enumDescriptions: Minimalist text mask without background styling
Subtle rounded pill badge with theme-tinted background
Lightly bordered box around the folded mask
classFold.badgeStyle.description: Visual decoration style for the folded mask badge.

classFold.maskColor.description: Custom text color for the folded mask (e.g. '#60a5fa' or 'rgba(150,150,150,0.8)'). Leave empty for theme-adaptive color.

classFold.badgeBackgroundColor.description: Custom background color for the pill/bordered badge (e.g. 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12)'). Leave empty for automatic theme tint.

classFold.opacity.description: Opacity of the folded mask (from 0.1 to 1.0).

enumDescriptions: Unfold only when the cursor is directly inside the folded attribute value
Unfold any folded attributes on the line where the cursor currently rests
Unfold only when the text is actively selected
Keep folded at all times (toggle manually via command or shortcut)
classFold.unfoldOn.description: Trigger condition for temporarily unfolding content.

classFold.minFoldLength.description: Minimum character length required to fold an attribute value. Shorter strings stay visible.

classFold.foldClasses.description: Fold HTML class, JSX className, Vue :class, Svelte class, and Tailwind tw attributes.

classFold.foldImages.description: Fold long image src URLs, srcset attributes, and large base64 data URIs.

classFold.foldSvgPaths.description: Fold long SVG path definitions (d="..." and points="...").

classFold.foldCustomAttributes.description: Fold custom attributes matching user-defined regular expressions.

classFold.customPatterns.description: Custom regular expressions to fold. Capture group 1 must wrap the content to hide. Example: 'href="([^"]*)"'

classFold.showHoverPreview.description: Show an informative hover tooltip displaying the full folded content, stats, and quick actions.

classFold.hoverImagePreview.description: Render a visual image thumbnail preview inside the hover tooltip for folded image src and base64 URLs.

classFold.showStatusBar.description: Display a Class Fold status indicator and live fold counter in the VS Code status bar.

classFold.debounceDelay.description: Debounce delay (in milliseconds) before re-indexing folds after document edits.

classFold.cursorDebounceDelay.description: Debounce delay (in milliseconds) before updating fold states when cursor moves.

classFold.activeLanguages.description: List of language identifiers where Class Fold will be active.
